notes: 'mean' is placed on the interrogative predicate מָה as the verbless clause's construction-supplied verb, following rule 20's treatment of מִי in מִי הָאִישׁ הַלָּזֶה; read as a lexical supply instead it would be added under rule 20's supplied-lexical-verb clause, but its work here is copular.
The 'them' of 'tell them' is added, since no object morpheme stands with that imperative (rule 44); the הֲ is unrepresented because the ASV marks the question by inversion alone (rule 17).
